full_prompt_en: A storybook illustration with fine ink contours and muted, print-like color shows a red-haired wanderer amid autumn foliage. She stands on the right half in a dark brown vest and ochre scarf, facing forward with a calm, slightly distant expression. Wind pulls her loose hair toward the right edge, and the ends echo the flowing shapes of the sky behind her. The lower left is filled with overlapping copper and golden leaves, their small outlined shapes forming a textured foreground that rises toward her shoulders. Across the upper and middle background, deep teal and olive bands twist in long, sinuous layers. Rounded ivory clouds sit within those bands, outlined delicately and shaded with faint hatch-like strokes; their pale masses keep the ornate sky from becoming heavy. The face is drawn with economical lines and soft rosy color, while the garment has flatter earth-toned planes, small buttons, and restrained fold marks. The image feels both decorative and narrative: the repeated curves of cloud, hair, scarf, and foliage hold the still figure inside a moving season. There is little realistic depth; instead, layered shapes and changing line density separate foreground from sky. The lighting is diffuse, with warm leaf color playing against the cool dark backdrop. The whole frame reads as a quiet autumn pause rendered in intricate, gently weathered graphic lines.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅带细致墨线轮廓与低饱和、版画般色彩的故事书插画，描绘一名红发旅人站在秋叶之间。她位于画面右半部，穿深棕色背心，围赭黄色围巾，正面朝前，神情平静而略带遥想。风将散开的头发牵向右侧边缘，发梢与身后天空流动的形状相呼应。左下方铺满重叠的铜色与金黄色叶片，细小的勾线形体形成有肌理的前景，并向她肩头升起。背景的上方和中段，深青色与橄榄色条带弯曲成细长、蜿蜒的层次。圆润的象牙白云朵嵌在这些条带中，轮廓纤细，内部由淡淡的排线状痕迹塑造；浅色云团也让繁复的天空不至于沉重。面部由节省的线条与柔和的玫瑰色绘成，衣服则采用更平整的土地色块、细小纽扣和克制的衣褶线。画面既有装饰性也有叙事感：云、头发、围巾和树叶反复出现的曲线，把安静的人物包在流动的季节里。真实空间深度并不强，前景和天空更多靠层叠形状与线条密度变化分开。光线柔和均匀，温暖叶色与冷暗背景彼此映衬。整幅画像秋日短暂的静默，由精细而略带旧感的图形线条呈现。
style_prompt_en: The storybook illustration uses fine ink contours, delicate interior hatching, and muted print-like fields of ochre, copper, olive, deep teal, and ivory. Long sinuous bands overlap across the upper area, interrupted by rounded pale shapes that keep the dense pattern breathable. A warmer, smaller-scale cluster of repeated marks anchors the lower edge. Form is defined chiefly by layered silhouettes and changes in line density, with only modest shading and little conventional depth. Curved strokes recur at several scales, giving still central space a sense of surrounding movement. Edges are crisp enough to reveal the drawing, yet the colors remain softly weathered rather than glossy. Diffuse illumination preserves the balance between warm earth tones and cool dark fields. The whole frame has a decorative, quietly narrative cadence shaped by intricate lines and restrained color.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅故事书插画使用细致墨线轮廓、轻巧的内部排线，以及赭黄、铜色、橄榄色、深青色和象牙白的低饱和版画式色域。细长蜿蜒的色带在上部彼此重叠，被圆润的浅色形状打断，使密集纹样仍能呼吸。下缘以较暖、尺度更小的重复笔迹聚拢。形体主要由层叠的剪影和线条密度的变化定义，阴影较克制，常规纵深感也不强。不同尺度的弯曲线条反复出现，让安定的中央空间感到周围仍有运动。边缘足够清晰，可以看见绘制痕迹，颜色却保持柔和的旧感而非光亮质地。漫射光维持温暖土地色与冷暗色域之间的平衡。整幅画具有装饰性和安静的叙事节奏，由繁密线条与克制色彩共同塑造。
theme_en: A red-haired wanderer in autumn wind
name: Autumn
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
